descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S12 Decision table: transcript source × trigger → becomes a prior entry or not (Tim's api and chromium tests)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating. (UAT TC-16; TFA-92594 How it works 1; TFA-92594 AC 2)
  • U11 Nothing invented or doubled: the list holds only lines that were recorded or dictated, with no added line (e.g. 'Encounter completed.') and no line listed twice. (UAT 3.4)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Cells: (1) bedside recording from an earlier day + first write of a new day → archived once as '<day> (prior)'. (2) Bedside, same day → grows in place, no second row. (3) Bedside from an earlier day + Generate with no recording today → archived, 'Most Recent' gone. …

When Cells 4, 1 and 2 run in Tim's api test: fresh patient, write with 'Wed Sep 24 2026', write with 'Thu Sep 25 2026', write again the same day with one more line, then read the audit row. Cell 3 runs in Tim's chromium test with a stale 2-line transcript, typed encounter text and a failing generateNote. …

Then Cell 4: the fresh patient had nothing to archive. Cell 1: exactly one history row 'Sep 24 (prior)' with yesterday's lines. Cell 2: the same-day write keeps one row. The audit row names transcriptHistory but not the text. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. api: transcriptHistory toEqual one row, then toHaveLength(1) after the same-day write (U1, U11); audit row JSON not.toContain the marker line (PHI risk). chromium: history toEqual [{label 'Sep 24 (prior)', entries stale}] and transcript [] (U1: not lost on Generate; U11: one row, not two); 'Most Recent' toHaveCount(0). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-16.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).
